name: CJC-1295 (Without DAC)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: CJC-1295 (Without DAC) (CND) is a structurally modified synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is CJC-1295 (Without DAC) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (Without DAC) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the CND certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 863288-34-0, formula C152H252N44O42, 3367.90 Da).

faq.question: How should CJC-1295 (Without DAC) be stored?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (Without DAC) ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for CJC-1295 (Without DAC)?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 (Without DAC) is stocked in 3 pack sizes (2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $40.32; 10–49 kits falls to $37.10 (−8%) and 50+ to $34.28 (−15%).
